title: Mall world escalators leading to different experiences
content: My mall world dreams usually consist of a huge open court similar to your typical food court. Many people are there as well. Like me, they seem to be trying to figure out where to go. In the middle are numerous amounts of escalators that go up, down, horizontally across the floor. And to the sides of the open food court area, there are exits into an even more open area that resembles a glass domed environment. It gives me a feeling like I am on a ship or futuristic environment. Sometimes when I take the escalator I zoom into the foyer entrance of a hotel. I am always trying to get to the very top of the hotel via elevator. The higher I go, the more I experience eerie things. Like something is following me or viewing me. Sometimes the elevator stops at floors that are completely dark besides the occasional hall light. In these corridors I feel an intense need to get to the emergency stairs.Quickly. Everytime I end up on these floors, I get the eerie feeling of being examined/watched. I usually become lucid and wake myself up in the stairs. Sometimes the corridors lead me to the hospital. The hospital has many people with a variety of deformities, missing limbs, and sickness. The feeling of being watched is not present here but the gore is just as unsettling. Sometimes the elevator leads to a dark red foyer that has many doors of which has a red theatre behind each of them. Sometimes the theater is empty. Sometimes it’s filled with many people watching a talent show. I seem to know all of these people. Some people I know and some people I do not recognize but “I know”. Sometimes I am in the audience. Sometimes I am in the show. The show seems to be a variety talent show that is leading to the “actual” show.
